<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def find(color, rmin, rmax):
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']==color and n['pixels']<=20:
            rows=[q[0] for q in n['boundary']]
            cols=[q[1] for q in n['boundary']]
            if rmin<=min(rows)<=rmax: return (min(rows),min(cols))
    return None

if pos is None or pos[1]<30:
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':28}])  # try green s2
    pos2 = find('R',32,41)
    print('after green s2 try, R at:', pos2, 'res:', last_action_result.get('no_impact'))
    pos = pos2
print('R final:', pos)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
